tha-ap432:2.3: upatitthaṁ → upaviṭṭhaṁ (bj) | upatitthaṁ samāpannaṁ indivaradalappabhaṁ alābunodakaṁ → upaviṭṭhaṁ samāpattiṁ indriyasaṁvarappahaṁ alāvunodakaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap432:3.3: buddhassa pāde dhovitvā alābukamadāsahaṁ → buddhapāde dhovitvāna alāvukamadāsahaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap432:4.2: padumuttaranāmako → padumuttaranāyako (bj) | padumuttaranāmako iminā dakamāhatvā → padamuttaranāyako imin odakam āhatvā (pts)
tha-ap432:4.3: iminā dakamāhatvā → iminodakamāhatvā (sya-all) | dakamāhatvā → imino dakamāhatvā (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap432:5.2: satthugāravatāya ca dakaṁ alābunāhatvā → satthu gāravatāyava udakaṁ lāvunāhatvā (sya-all)
tha-ap432:5.3: alābunāhatvā buddhaseṭṭhaṁ upāgamiṁ → alābunāhitvā buddhaseṭṭhamupānayiṁ (bj) | alābunā’hitvā → alābunāhitvā (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap432:7.1: pannarasesu → paṇṇarasasu (bj) | pannarasesu kappesu → paṇṇarase ito kappe (sya-all)
tha-ap432:7.4: cakkavattī → cakkavatti (sya-all) | ahosahaṁ divā → ahos ahaṁ diva (pts)
tha-ap432:8.4: tiṭṭhate → tiṭṭhanti (sya-all); tiṭṭhati (pts) | tiṭṭhate → tiṭṭhanti (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap432:9.1: datvānalābuṁ → lābuṁ datvāna (bj); datvāna lāvuṁ (sya-all) | datvāna → datvāna lābu (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap432:10.2: yaṁlābumadadiṁ → yaṁ lāvumadadiṁ (sya-all); yam alābum adaṁ (pts)
tha-ap432:18.3: kadambakoraṇḍakado ghatassavanikopi → kadambakoraṇḍakadā ghataṁ savaṇiko pi (bj) | kadambakoraṇḍakadā → kadambakoraṇḍakado (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap432:19.1: sucintiko → sucintito (bj) | sucintiko kiṅkaṇiko soṇṇakontarikopi → sucintito kiṅkhaniko soṇṇakattariko pi (pts)
tha-ap432:19.3: ekagāthāsatañcettha → ekaṁ gāthāsatañceva (bj) | gāthāsatañceva → ekagāthā satañcettha (bj: machasaṁ)
